questions.text: Which country is shaped like a boot?
The Panama Canal links the Atlantic with which ocean?
questions.explanation: The canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

questions.text: What is the capital of Portugal?
questions.explanation: Lisbon is Portugal's capital and largest city.
Rome grew up on the banks of the Tiber.

questions.text: Which is the largest country in South America by area?
questions.explanation: Brazil covers roughly half of South America.

questions.text: Which Scandinavian capital lies largely on the island of Zealand?
questions.explanation: Copenhagen sits mainly on Zealand, with part on Amager.

questions.text: Which of the North American Great Lakes is largest by surface area?
questions.explanation: Lake Superior has the greatest surface area of the five.

questions.text: Which mountain range separates France from Spain?
questions.explanation: The Pyrenees form the natural border between France and Spain.

questions.text: What is the capital of Ecuador?
questions.explanation: Quito, high in the Andes, is Ecuador's capital.

questions.text: Which river forms much of the border between Mexico and the United States?
questions.explanation: The Rio Grande marks a large part of the Texas-Mexico border.

questions.text: Which landlocked country lies between Austria and Switzerland?
questions.explanation: Liechtenstein borders both Austria and Switzerland.

questions.text: Which strait separates Tierra del Fuego from mainland South America?
questions.explanation: The Strait of Magellan lies between the mainland and Tierra del Fuego.

questions.text: Which is the longest river in Asia?
questions.explanation: The Yangtze is about 6,300 km long.

questions.text: Which Central American country abolished its army in 1948?
questions.explanation: Costa Rica abolished its standing army after the 1948 civil war.

questions.text: Which is the highest peak in the Andes?
questions.explanation: Aconcagua in Argentina rises to about 6,960 m.

spares.text: Which country is home to the city of Amsterdam?
spares.explanation: Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands.

spares.text: What is the capital of Chile?
spares.explanation: Santiago has been Chile's capital since the colonial era.

spares.text: Which European microstate is the smallest country in the world by area?
spares.explanation: Vatican City covers about 0.44 square kilometres.
